Game Overview

Mummy Candies is a action game built around guide a spirited mummy on a candy-collecting journey filled with vibrant graphics and lively music. Master precise tapping to dodge explosive pumpkins across 20 thrilling levels. Each sweet victory unlocks more challenges, requiring sharp skills and strategic movements in this addictive and colorful adventure.
